runtimeStatus: B&W 0.3.0 has been tested in-game, as confirmed by the maintainer on 2026-11-01. This audit does not assign invented per-feature test coverage. The LLW 440-19 model author confirmed the separate A-19 prototype worked in-game. Its three baked cycles and wheel-phase/reverser blend apply to that conventional model. A clean official ADK with Unity 6000.3.26f1 passed automated headless checks for conventional and articulated practice locomotive previews, independent section speeds, ordinary comparison, and building and reopening one player pack. Blender 4.5.16 verified every frame of four FBX takes from an original one-sided practice mechanism. The clean ADK sampled 366 poses on those files and reopened the built pack. The author guide records the measured half-gear pin gaps and explains how to try the source mechanism with its ordinary driver preconfigured. In-game validation of the general 0.4.0 runtime remains open. The steam-plant proposal planned for 0.4.0 is an author-review document, not a working example pack or a gameplay-validation claim. The published combined artifact retains its recorded offline/native fixture qualification. An unreleased follow-up candidate passed isolated native Climax operation/audio, world and model lifecycle, real Relay consumers, oil/wood operation and accounting, finite facilities with persistence, existing feature coupling/off-screen checks, and native editor presentation on Railroader 0.6.2 build 26335745 / Unity 6000.3.26f1. It also passed successor curve/reload/author-audio fixtures and 8,518 offline tests, with 16 existing skips. These results apply to that development candidate, not the published 0.3.0 DLL. The editor fixture's cross-pack animation-name picker logged a native bundle lookup error; preview, explicit animation controls and saving passed. Real multiplayer acceptance remains open because a second authenticated client was unavailable. See the runtime-validation page for scope and limitations. On 2026-11-17, the final 0.3.1 DLL passed 8,518 offline tests (16 existing skips), 13 executable integration checks and 430 native assertions on Railroader 0.6.3 experimental build 26740326 / Unity 6000.3.28f1. Coverage includes isolated homes, Bunker-C/pulpwood supply, oil/wood firing, actual Relay consumers, world/model reload, finite facilities, existing features, tested editor presentation, concurrent native curves, diagnostic reload, moving Climax audio and two-pack author audio. Every native player job exited cleanly with normal settings unchanged. Editor Data.rl-dependent oil/wood declarations still logged validation errors; that path is not qualified. Real multiplayer remains unavailable. See runtime-validation for exact scope.
